sam_sales: Quick thread: Lyra Capital wants a POC. They're asking us to validate two variants (Falcon-70B-q4_0 and Falcon-70B-ptq-v2) for a production search/chat workload. Expected steady ~150 qps, spikes ~850 qps. Key asks: compatibility for streaming chat + batched embeddings, perf numbers with 3k token prefixes, and a pricing sketch (Dedicated vs Hosted vs hybrid). They also attached a security questionnaire due in 4 business days.

anya_se: Got it. Do they need strict KV-cache warm behavior (sticky sessions) or can we rely on prefix caching best-effort?

sam_sales: They prefer sticky to minimize latency for repeated large-context conversations.

chris_infra: Starting variant scans on us-west-dedicated. Running with batch=8, seq=3072. Command: `redwood-variant-check --model Falcon-70B-q4_0 --seq-len 3072 --batch 8 --tests perf,stream,kv`

ci-bot: job started (id: scan-1897524310-1) :hammer_and_wrench:

chris_infra: Early results: q4_0 passes ops (streaming and embeddings) but unstable matmul when batch >8 with kv warm at driver 545; p50 token ~130ms (seq=1024), p95 ~410ms. At seq=3072 p95 ~950-1.1s. Lowering batch to 6 for stable runs. Uploading raw logs shortly.

chris_infra: ptq-v2: fails on int8 kernel symbol missing in our quant lib. KernelWorks fallback not present. Filing infra ticket INF-7902 and asking model team for a PTQ build compatible with our runtime.

anya_se: That's expected on some ptq builds. Advice to customer: either provide a variant compiled for our quant stack or use QAT/PTQ with per-channel quantization. I'll draft compatibility guidance.

lee_security: I reviewed their questionnaire. They require KMS/HSM, SOC2, and 12-month audit log retention. We support KMS and audit logs but 12-month retention requires enterprise plan or legal approval. I'll draft answers and mark items for legal/ops.

rachel_product: Pricing note: propose hybrid baseline (Dedicated sized for 150 qps steady + Hosted bursts). Hybrid reduces expected monthly cost by ~20% vs Hosted-only for their traffic profile. I'll prepare a one-slide comparison with commit sizing options.

sam_sales: Action items: chris -> finish both scans and upload perf table + logs; rachel -> pricing slide; lee -> questionnaire draft and legal flags; anya -> compatibility notes for sales deck. Please ack.

chris_infra: Ack. Uploading perf CSV to https://internal.storage/reports/scan-1897524310.csv

rachel_product: Ack. Slide by 09:30 PST tomorrow.

lee_security: Ack. I'll loop in legal today.

anya_se: Ack. Will write up fallback patterns and recommended model builds.

sam_sales: Thanks team. If PTQ fix is delayed, we'll propose QAT or longer lead time to customer. :thumbsup:
